memo.summary: Context-only shadow deliberation as of 2026-10-10: the US backdrop is MIXED (53), with improving trend and calm volatility offset by exceptionally weak participation, neutral-hollow liquidity, widening high-yield credit, restrictive/rising real yields, and cross-asset disagreement. Risk-radar intensity is receding and its current caution cell is not above its measured base rate, so it does not justify escalation. The confirmed Q2 label is low-confidence and internally unsupported: raw axes indicate Q1, now 4 of 7 confirmation sessions. Factor evidence is immature (9 dates versus the 60-date floor), Pair G is dormant, and no factor-attention authority has been earned. Six neutral attention items were recorded with explicit falsifiers. A narrow-leadership hypothesis was drafted but not registered because the weekly metabolism budget is already 3/3; no existing hypothesis was retired.
what_fired: Displayed US regime-label mismatch: confirmed Q2 at 0.08 confidence versus raw Q1 axes, pending 4/7 sessions.
Breadth/credit tension: 48.3% of members above the 200-day average, breadth at the 11th percentile with price divergence, while HY OAS widened about 39 bp over 21 days.
Cross-asset confirmation verdict is diverge with 0% bonds/FX agreement; FX and rates-credit contradict the displayed Q2 regime.
Liquidity quality remains neutral-hollow: RRP buffer is exhausted, net liquidity declined over 20 and 65 days, and stress confirmation is active.
Master-Brain thesis conflicts were surfaced for semiconductors, growth over value, long Treasuries, and the China-equity overweight thesis.
No Pair G factor contradiction fired; the ledger is absent until the panel reaches at least 60 distinct dates.
memo.contradictions_review: The central contradiction is resilient headline tape versus deteriorated internals: trend score 70, volatility score 87, leadership INTACT, and systematic funds aligned adding coexist with breadth score 0, weak equal-weight/small-cap participation, credit stress, and hollow liquidity. This supports attention, not a directional claim. The regime label is also transitional: Q2 remains displayed while its own axes read Q1. Bonds and FX do not confirm the equity regime. Current Master-Brain records contain overdue open theses whose stated checks have passed: semiconductor underweights conflict with current semiconductor/technology leadership; growth-underweight theses conflict with IWF/IWD +5.14% and QQQ/SPY +3.08% over 20 days; long-Treasury overweight theses conflict with a 2.92% real 10-year yield, rising term premium, and bear steepening; the China-overweight thesis conflicts with China risk-off conditions, contracting liquidity, deep property contraction, and technology/AI breadth of 0.05. Factor Pair G contributes no evidence because it is dormant.

deserves_operator: US regime-label transition — clear if pending Q1 fails to reach 7/7 and axes return to Q2 support; retain if Q1 confirms while Q2 remains displayed. Attention claim 01328839f175e54e.

US narrow-leadership fragility — clear if breadth exceeds 55% above the 200-day average and HY widening falls below +15 bp; retain if breadth stays below 50% with HY widening at least +30 bp or leadership deteriorates. Attention claim ca7a5b6a2f32586f.

Overdue semiconductor-underweight theses — clear if SMH underperforms SPY over five sessions and semiconductor breadth falls below 50%; retain if SMH/SPY stays positive and semiconductor/hardware breadth remains at least 0.67. Attention claim fa6f5cbe97eff7c4.
